title: value
body_html:
value

Lean type

lean def value : GameTree → ℚ | Leaf r => r | Pnode p L R => match p with | .A => max L.value R.value | .B => min L.value R.value | Nnode prob L R => prob * L.value + (1 - prob) * R.value /-- **A's dominant strategy**: at each A-node, move to whichever child has the higher value; ties go left. -/

Dependencies

  • none
